description: This file defines the 'EditView' class within the 'Step\Acceptance' namespace, extending the AcceptanceTester class. It contains methods for interacting with an edit view in acceptance tests, such as waiting for the edit view to become visible and clicking the save button.

classes.name: EditView
classes.description: Represents acceptance test steps related to the edit view in the application.

methods.name: waitForEditViewVisible
methods.description: Waits until the edit view element ('#EditView') becomes visible in the UI.

methods.name: clickSaveButton
methods.description: Scrolls to the top of the window and clicks the 'Save' button.
